representation.name: Rank complete 1 Mb BigWig windows
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
: > windows.bed
while IFS=$'\t' read -r chrom start chrom_end; do
  s=0
  while let "s+1000000<=chrom_end"; do
    let "e=s+1000000"
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s:%s-%s\n' "$chrom" "$s" "$e" "$chrom" "$s" "$e" >> windows.bed
    let "s=e"
  done
done < '$(inputs.chroms.path)'
bigWigAverageOverBed '$(inputs.signal.path)' windows.bed scores.tsv
sort -k4,4gr scores.tsv | head -n 10 > top10.tsv
wc -l < windows.bed > qc.txt
head -n 2 windows.bed >> qc.txt
tail -n 2 windows.bed >> qc.txt
